recent_release_evaluations.release_scope: Seven Oct13 releases plus car-buying-checklist 0.1.2 and morning-briefing 0.1.2 published Oct15.
recent_release_evaluations.scoring_method: Calculated arithmetic mean of 15 item scores; not an official platform aggregate, user satisfaction, or controlled experiment.
recent_release_evaluations.comparison_limit: Seven records are identical to Oct15 and must not be described as newly generated or newly improved. Car/morning baselines were still bound to 0.1.1 in the Oct15 release readback; current evaluations bind 0.1.2. Their saved baseline means were rounded to three decimals.

interpretation_limits: Download counters do not identify unique users or completed tasks; they can include maintainer acceptance downloads after baseline.
Aggregate growth cannot be causally attributed to the nine upgrades or either community article.
API installs=0 does not establish zero installations or zero users.
Nine target comment counters are zero; other SkillHub comments and private channels were not queried.
Three favorites do not establish three independent people or repeat usage.
Inventory count does not establish current quota or remaining publishing capacity.
Version-bound automated evaluations and benign scanner statuses do not establish actual user success or complete correctness/security.
Article showReadNum is a displayed counter, not unique readers. Article likes, favorites and comments do not prove independent user identity or task completion.
GitHub Discussions, private communication and WorkBuddy internal feedback were not covered.
This snapshot describes the observed times; later releases or visits can change versions and counters.
